# Hex

> Hex is an AI analytics platform for trusted data exploration, agentic notebooks, conversational self-serve analytics, and interactive data apps.

Hex workspace data is private: product API calls require a bearer token, and MCP tools require an OAuth connection to the user's workspace.

## When to use Hex

- [Hex MCP server](https://learn.hex.tech/docs/api-integrations/mcp-server): Use for agent-led data questions, project search, and Hex Threads in a user's workspace.
- [Hex public API](https://learn.hex.tech/docs/api-integrations/api/overview): Use for deterministic project execution and workspace administration.
- [Hex CLI](https://learn.hex.tech/docs/api-integrations/cli): Use for scripted project workflows, local exports, and terminal automation.

## Agent access

- [Hex product OpenAPI](https://static.hex.site/openapi.json): Complete machine-readable contract for the authenticated Hex product API.
- [Hex MCP setup](https://learn.hex.tech/docs/api-integrations/mcp-server): Supported clients, OAuth setup, available tools, and usage guidance.

- [API overview and authentication](https://learn.hex.tech/docs/api-integrations/api/overview): Bearer-token setup, base URLs, examples, errors, and rate limits.

- [API and integrations index](https://learn.hex.tech/docs/api-integrations): Product API, CLI, MCP, Slack, and external app documentation.
